name: Microsoft Teams
summary: Teams agents are bots registered with Microsoft and built with the Teams SDK (formerly Teams AI library v2), which handles authentication, event routing and Teams-specific features. A Teams Developer CLI scaffolds, registers and sideloads apps, and agents can stream replies, use slash commands, reactions and prompt starters. Organizations control which apps users may install.
facts: MCP and A2A support in Teams SDK
Teams Developer CLI, Microsoft 365 Agents Playground
goodFor: Agents that need Entra ID identity and Graph data
watchOut: Tenant admins decide whether custom apps can be installed
Several SDK generations and renames to navigate
